purpose: Teach: 滑走/注入/征服/履修/標高/図形/代謝/点滴

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、空港の滑走路設計を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote that paper on runway design, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, genuinely curious. Leans forward slightly. The measured pace of someone who's read the work and is inviting the student to talk about it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、燃料の注入工程を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I actually focused on the fuel injection process.
lines.style: Quiet pride beneath the surface. Direct eye contact. A small pause before answering, choosing her words carefully. Not rehearsed, just honest.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 植民地の征服史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the colonial conquest history paper — that was you too?
lines.style: Thoughtful, careful tone. Slower pace. Not testing, but genuinely wanting to understand how these topics connect. Slight tilt of the head.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、学部の履修制度の改革を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — though I actually centered it on curriculum reform in the undergraduate system.
lines.style: Steady, matter-of-fact. She's correcting gently, not defensively. A slight lift at the end, opening the topic wider.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 高地の標高別生態系を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the high-altitude ecosystem paper — was that also part of your research?
lines.style: Attentive, following the pattern. Warm and unhurried. The kind of listening that makes a student feel genuinely seen and taken seriously.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、数学教育の図形指導を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I wrote about geometric instruction in mathematics education instead.
lines.style: Calm, assured. She's found her rhythm now. A gentle firmness in her tone, as if she's used to clarifying what she actually studied.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 新陳代謝の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the metabolism research — that was another one of yours?
lines.style: Reflective, almost gently amused. A pause between each phrase. There's a warmth here, like she's noticing something interesting about how Sakura's mind works.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、点滴投与の医療史を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes — I focused on the medical history of intravenous therapy.
lines.style: Final note of certainty. Clear and direct. A slight exhale, as if she's been waiting to clarify this last one. Grounded, not defensive.
